crossRefs.note: That which makes a man to be desired is his kindness. A poor man is better than a liar.
A righteous person is cautious in friendship, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.
Better is little, with the fear of Yahweh, than great treasure with trouble.
Better is a little with righteousness, than great revenues with injustice.
Better is the poor who walks in his integrity, than he who is perverse in his ways, and he is rich.
All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His offspring is blessed.
For what will it profit a man, if he gains the whole world, and forfeits his life? Or what will a man give in exchange…
Listen, my beloved brothers. Didn’t God choose those who are poor in this world to be rich in faith, and heirs of the…
But you have dishonored the poor man. Don’t the rich oppress you, and personally drag you before the courts?
Now therefore know and consider what you will do; for evil is determined against our master, and against all his house…
Please don’t let my lord pay attention to this worthless fellow, Nabal; for as his name is, so is he. Nabal is his…
For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity. Your lips have spoken lies. Your tongue mutters…
Therefore I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be…

translations.web: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his lips and is a fool.
translations.bsb: Better a poor man who walks with integrity than a fool whose lips are perverse.
translations.kjv: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity, than he that is perverse in his lips, and is a fool.
translations.asv: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity Than he that is perverse in his lips and is a fool.
